col.name: detail.hiddenFromUI
Name: Hidden by the game UI flag

col.name: menu.about
Name: BuffHUD设计创意出自 Icarus ，本人享有创意署名权，项目工程由 WorkBuddy 中转DS-V4.1 Flash & V4-Pro 完成。受众人喜爱的项目，将在三个工作日内开源。

col.name: menu.enabled.desc
Name: When off, nothing is collected or drawn. Re-enable any time.

col.name: menu.maxRows.desc
Name: Extra effects collapse into a '+N' row to keep the panel compact.

col.name: menu.anchor.desc
Name: Which corner the panel sticks to, so it can avoid other HUD mods.

col.name: menu.sort.desc
Name: The list is only re-sorted when data changes; switching applies immediately.

col.name: menu.merge.desc
Name: Stack the same magic effect into one row and show the stack count.

col.name: menu.showTime.desc
Name: Turn off for a minimal icon-and-name layout.

col.name: menu.showSource.desc
Name: Source is the spell, potion or item that applied the effect.

col.name: menu.hideInactive.desc
Name: Some effects sit on the actor while their conditions are false; hidden by default.

col.name: menu.opacity.desc
Name: Affects the backdrop only; icons and text stay fully opaque.

col.name: menu.theme.desc
Name: Parchment is close to vanilla, cool grey is modern, high contrast suits dim rooms.

col.name: menu.tint.desc
Name: Buffs amber, debuffs crimson, neutral slate. Off renders everything bone white.

col.name: menu.key.desc
Name: Hold past the threshold to open; a short tap toggles the pinned state.

col.name: menu.hold.desc
Name: How long to hold before the panel opens. 300-450 is a good range.

col.name: menu.combatOnly.desc
Name: Show the panel only while the player is in combat; it collapses the moment the fight ends.

col.name: menu.showHidden
Name: Show effects hidden by the game

col.name: menu.showHidden.desc
Name: Vanilla flags some technical effects as hidden in the UI; force them visible.

col.name: menu.debug.desc
Name: Shows the magic effect form, archetype and instance ID in the details pane.

col.name: menu.language.desc
Name: Affects the panel and details pane only.
